title: Activity Inequality Raises Obesity Risk By 197%
hook: Obesity tracks unequal activity more closely than average steps.
closing: Closing the activity gap may matter more than telling everyone to walk equally farther.
question: Who gets left behind where you live?

segments.say: Hong Kong averages 6,880 daily steps. Indonesia barely reaches half, showing how widely everyday movement differs.
Obesity likelihood is 197% higher where activity is most unequal. The gap predicts risk better than an average.
The gender step gap explains 43% of worldwide activity inequality. Unequal opportunity to move becomes unequal health.
